protocol.label: Declared 120-second development screen; original geometry; 10s forecast, 2s replans. Five matched formulations plus discrete-monitor sensitivity. No held-out efficacy claim.

interpretation.control_pair: Same 100D controls and frozen forecast belief; RPCBF vs shield-only vs transformed Safe-MPD
interpretation.discrete_sensitivity: Paper-style endpoint monitor (1 substep) vs dense monitor (4); same independent 32-substep physical audit; retain all failures.

audit.timing_definition: First two cycles reported separately; remaining cycles include input preparation, previous real POAM update and full selected-trajectory check.
audit.limits: Development seed; empirical dense collision check, no formal safety claim. Oracle is explicitly privileged.
